module: Node "Screen Finish" (repeat_instant, color ui). Ends the building of a screen (start or end) and sends it to the UI. Input flow (chainFlow), output flow. To be placed at the end of the chain after StartScreen Begin / EndScreen Begin and the panel nodes.
notes: The output flow pin is never written by work.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Emits the onStartScreenFinishedBuilding hook then calls modules.ui:finishUIBuilding().
